_comment: SENTINEL mesh manifest. index.html ships ~41 built-in cams; anything added here is merged on top at runtime (deduped by yt/hls id). This is the file the host app writes to. Each entry needs lat + lon and either 'yt' (YouTube video id) or 'hls' (.m3u8 url). Served over http(s) so the browser can fetch it (file:// blocks local fetch).
